item.title: WATCH: Hundreds of thousands of dollars in public subsidies …
item.author: ProPublica (@propublica.org)
item.description:
WATCH: Hundreds of thousands of dollars in public subsidies goes to funding internet service to unlivable buildings on Alaska’s Adak Island.

@kylehopkinsak.bsky.social knocked on every door and talked to every person he could find.

Not a single person told him they used the service.
